name: Temporary WP-MVP-0005 post-exec integration

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - ops/wp-mvp-0005-post-exec-integration

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  integrate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 40
    env:
      EOS_ACTOR: eos-evidence-refresh
    steps:
      - name: Check out verified product branch
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683
        with:
          ref: wp/mvp-0005
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Configure commit identity
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

      - name: Merge exact current canonical main
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          git fetch origin main
          test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "913517ced543d6a244e4d15a1ec5ec197eae6053"
          set +e
          git merge --no-commit --no-ff origin/main
          status=$?
          set -e
          if [ "$status" -ne 0 ]; then
            conflicts="$(git diff --name-only --diff-filter=U)"
            test -n "$conflicts"
            while IFS= read -r path; do
              case "$path" in
                machine/*)
                  git checkout --theirs -- "$path"
                  git add -- "$path"
                  ;;
                *)
                  echo "Unexpected non-derived merge conflict: $path" >&2
                  exit 1
                  ;;
              esac
            done <<< "$conflicts"
          fi
          test -z "$(git diff --name-only --diff-filter=U)"

      - name: Validate combined product tree
        run: |
          cargo fmt --all
          cargo fmt --all -- --check
          cargo test -p monad-core
          cargo clippy -p monad-core --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings -A clippy::large_enum_variant
          git diff --check -- crates/monad-core/src/
          python3 tools/eos/trace_integrity.py --write
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --write
          python3 tools/eos/trace_integrity.py
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --check
          python3 scripts/generate-mvp-work-packets.py --check
          python3 scripts/populate-artifact-system.py --check
          ./scripts/eos state status

      - name: Commit post-execution integration merge
        run: |
          git add -A
          git diff --cached --check -- crates/monad-core/src/
          git commit -m "chore(core): integrate verified WP-MVP-0005 with current main"

      - name: Recertify affected predecessor Work Packets
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          for target in WP-MVP-0001 WP-MVP-0002 WP-MVP-0003 WP-MVP-0004; do
            ./scripts/eos validate "$target" --profile wp
          done

      - name: Regenerate and strictly verify recertified state
        run: |
          python3 tools/eos/trace_integrity.py --write
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --write
          python3 tools/eos/trace_integrity.py
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --check
          python3 scripts/generate-mvp-work-packets.py --check
          python3 scripts/populate-artifact-system.py --check
          ./scripts/eos state status
          ./scripts/eos verify --strict

      - name: Commit recertification and publish product branch
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          git add .eos engineering/evidence machine
          if ! git diff --quiet; then
            echo "Unexpected unstaged changes outside governed evidence/projection paths:" >&2
            git status --short >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          if ! git diff --cached --quiet; then
            git commit -m "chore(eos): recertify predecessors after WP-MVP-0005 integration"
          fi
          git push origin HEAD:wp/mvp-0005

metadata.title: Tmp Wp Mvp 0005 Post Exec Integration
